items.title: Cessna Citation crashes in mountainous area of western Mexico
items.summary: A Cessna Citation crashed in mountainous western Mexico on October 4. Rescuers found the wreckage the next day, with two pilots reported dead. The post Cessna Citation crashes in mountainous area of western Mexico appeared first on AeroTime .
